h1: Custom 55 Inch Umbrellas for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 55 inch umbrellas in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for corporate gifts and events. Get your quote today!
introHtml: Custom 55 inch umbrellas offer a generous canopy that keeps two people dry in a downpour, making them a practical promotional item for outdoor events, trade shows, and employee gifts. The large size provides ample space for your logo or message, with decoration options like full-color imprint or screen printing on the canopy. Choose from auto-open or manual styles in a range of colors to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom 55 inch umbrellas with corporate logo, large canopy, and sturdy frame for bulk orders
